craft_notes: Sthāyin: thought-offering (edition distinction kept; variant on record). Rows: row 2 (seated→praise). Close: praise. Rejected: thought-flowers (variant) — killed: distinction kept (edition text; variant lives in L0/argmap, never smuggled); 'spreads out' — killed: spreads kept (vidadhāti as laying-out).

lines: She spreads Bhairava honor, south petal throned, with distinction-blooms —
l4.sanskrit_cite: vidadhāti bhairavārcāṃ dakṣiṇadalagā viṣeśakusumairyā | nityaṃ manaḥsvarūpāṃ kaumārīṃ tāmahaṃ vande

reads_against.argmap: Who offers thoughts? → Kaumārī (manas, south/Yama petal) offers thoughts; edition viśeṣa adopted (flower-pattern fit), variant vikalpa recorded (fits mind-goddess).
c1_essence: Kaumārī mind-formed offers distinction-flowers from the south: thoughts themselves the gift.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder circling home to rest)
